heroHeadline: Brugada Calls for National Unity at Zócalo Event as Rain Slows Nine Metro Lines
heroSubtitle: Clara Brugada welcomed President Sheinbaum to the September 27 'Honesty and Results' event at the Zócalo and called for national unity. On September 30, rain forced safety-speed operation on Metro Lines 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12 and B, with average delays near seven minutes.
